instrument: MDEQ Permit Board construction permit, MZX Tech (xAI) Southaven turbines (Mar 10, 2026)
summary: Permit Board unanimously approved a construction permit for 41 permanent gas turbines at the Southaven site powering Colossus 2 in Memphis, to replace unpermitted units already operating.

source.citation: Mississippi Free Press; SELC; E&E News, Mar 2026

notes: DISPUTED: unpermitted turbine count - 27 (xAI, January 2026; lawsuit), 35 confirmed / up to 46 (plaintiffs, Mar 28, 2026), 57 in Southaven plus 2 elsewhere (MDEQ-Trinity Consultants emails via records request, July 2026). CONFLICT: one outlet describes the permit as covering the 27 units. SELC filed an administrative appeal.
